event.bram_heart2.0.text: Hm. You again. Come here. Stand where the floor's swept.
event.bram_heart2.0.why: gruff welcome with a practical order; the sweep shows he planned for company

event.bram_heart2.1.text: Watch the color. Cherry, not yellow. Yellow is iron showing off.
event.bram_heart2.1.why: a specific craft lesson; teasing aimed at the iron

event.bram_heart2.2.text: Here. Copper. Tuition runs backward in this shop.
event.bram_heart2.2.why: covers the copper-bar gift with a dry joke instead of affection

event.bram_heart5.0.text: Hm. Wait. I don't say things often. Today I'm saying one.
event.bram_heart5.0.why: sets up the rare speech; economy is the joke

event.bram_heart5.1.text: You treat a good tool like a friend. Oil, rag, a dry shelf. Here.
event.bram_heart5.1.why: praise through concrete habits he has noticed

event.bram_heart5.2.text: Look after them. Iron keeps score.
event.bram_heart5.2.why: two bars given; a craft-metaphor close that works alone

event.next_door.2.why: the moved Hm; he is undone before he speaks

event.next_door.3.text: Shoulder's thin. A hair. The good tongs are on the bench. If you want them.
event.next_door.3.why: offers help without taking over; his fear of keeping her small

event.next_door.4.why: the payoff from heart 8, said plainly with her name first

event.hall_dance.7.text: Hm. Hm-hm. Hm. I sing it in my own language.
event.hall_dance.7.why: joins the chorus in the only words he has

event.story_whistler_bram.intro.text: {pause=0.5}...Hm. How long have you been standing there?
event.story_whistler_bram.intro.why: removes stage directions from spoken text; caught-out deadpan

dlg.story.whistler.bram.0.text: Hm. I whistle. Don't tell Wren. She'd count the notes as words.

dlg.story.whistler.bram.c0.text: Wave and say a cheerful hello.

dlg.story.whistler.bram.r0.text: Hm. Hello. Yes. We'll both say that was the kettle.
dlg.story.whistler.bram.r0.why: accepts the normal approach by inventing an alibi

dlg.story.whistler.bram.r1.text: Hm? ...That's my wrong note. Twenty years. Nobody's ever caught it.
dlg.story.whistler.bram.r1.why: the confused Hm, then quiet pleasure at being known

dlg.story.whistler.bram.r2.text: ...Hm. You listened. All of it. Most people leave before the end.
dlg.story.whistler.bram.r2.why: moved Hm; being heard matters to him

event.story_whistler_bram.after.text: Hm. My teacher whistled that tune. Got the note wrong too. I kept it.
event.story_whistler_bram.after.why: the wrong note becomes inheritance; points at the teacher

dlg.story.band.talk.2.text: Hm. One hit. I'm saving it for the end.
dlg.story.band.talk.2.why: stakes his single strike like a showman, deadpan

event.bram_heart4.intro.text: Hm. You. Hands free? Good. I need two more.

dlg.bram.repair.0.text: Old hoe. Split socket, blade's still good. Hold it, strike it, or watch?
dlg.bram.repair.0.why: specific job, then the three roles

dlg.bram.repair.r0.why: a real lesson in five words

dlg.bram.repair.r1.text: Square on. Again. ...Hm. The iron believed you.

dlg.bram.repair.r2.text: Hm. Watch the edge, not me. Juno watches me. Bad habit.
dlg.bram.repair.r2.why: teaches, and lets slip his worry about Juno

event.bram_heart4.after.text: Hm. It'll hold. Juno would've used half the strikes. Don't tell her.
event.bram_heart4.after.why: pride in Juno he will not say to her face

event.bram_heart6.intro.text: Hm. Sit. Not on the bucket. This'll be long. For me.
event.bram_heart6.intro.why: warns of the speech; bucket is specific

dlg.bram.long.0.text: I worked alone for years, told myself I liked it, and lied. Then you kept sitting down. I wrote my teacher thirty letters. Sent none.
dlg.bram.long.0.why: his longest sentence, at the twelve-word cap, then the letters

dlg.bram.long.c1.text: Tell him you're glad he said it.

dlg.bram.long.r0.text: ...Hm. A nod. That's how my teacher said yes.
dlg.bram.long.r0.why: the silent answer echoes the teacher

dlg.bram.long.r1.text: Glad. Hm. Good word. I'll keep it.
dlg.bram.long.r1.why: treats the word like a found tool

dlg.bram.long.r2.text: One word. ...Hm. That's all I ever wanted back.
dlg.bram.long.r2.why: names his want: one word from the teacher

event.bram_heart6.after.text: Hm. That's all of it. The letters stay in the drawer. For now.
event.bram_heart6.after.why: closes the speech and leaves the letters open

event.bram_heart8.intro.text: Hm. Juno made something. On her own. Look at it before I ruin it.
event.bram_heart8.intro.why: fear of saying the wrong thing, said sideways

dlg.bram.juno.0.text: A horseshoe. Crooked by a thumb. She's out back, pretending not to wait. What do I say?
dlg.bram.juno.0.why: specific flaw, Juno's nerves, his helplessness

dlg.bram.juno.r0.text: Wonderful. Hm. Crooked and wonderful. Both true. I can say both.
dlg.bram.juno.r0.why: finds he can be honest and kind at once

dlg.bram.juno.r1.text: Hm. Tease. I can do that. Teasing's just praise with a dent.
dlg.bram.juno.r1.why: craft metaphor for how he loves

dlg.bram.juno.r2.text: ...Hm. Me. My first shoe was crooked the same way.
dlg.bram.juno.r2.why: he sees himself; the sad expression carries it

event.bram_heart8.after.text: Hm. I'll tell her. Today. Or near today.
event.bram_heart8.after.why: the promise and the dodge in one line; sets up Next Door

event.bram_heart10.intro.text: Hm. Hold out your hands. Don't speak. It's easier.
event.bram_heart10.intro.why: fixes 'made you something' (the gold was saved, not made)

event.bram_heart10.thanks.text: {if choice:bram.juno.ask}You asked me what I see. Hm. I see a friend. Rare metal.{else}...Hm. Saved it nine winters. Didn't know who for. Now I do.{/if}
event.bram_heart10.thanks.why: each branch says the feeling through metal or time

event.bram_friend.intro.text: Hm. Wednesday. Marcus's day off. His half of the bench is free.
event.bram_friend.intro.why: explains the invitation through the bench, not friendship

event.bram_friend.doing.text: Bread's yours. Cheese is mine. Silence we split.
event.bram_friend.doing.why: the sharing is the affection; funniest word last

event.bram_friend.wrap.text: Hm. Good lunch. Don't tell Marcus. He thinks the bench is his.
event.bram_friend.wrap.why: warm close that points back at Marcus

event.bram_birthday.intro.text: Hm. Birthday. No fuss. Juno made a card, mostly diagrams. No other mail.
event.bram_birthday.intro.why: Juno's card plus a quiet note that the teacher did not write

dlg.bram.birthday.r0.text: A good year. Hm. I'll forge one. Slowly.
dlg.bram.birthday.r0.why: takes the wish as a job

dlg.bram.birthday.r1.text: ...Hm. For me? It goes on the shelf. Next to the card.
dlg.bram.birthday.r1.why: moved; the gift gets a place of honor

dlg.bram.birthday.r2.text: Hm. Sit. Left side's warmer. I checked.

event.bram_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.bram.wish}Hm. A good year starts with iron. Here. One bar. Don't argue.{else}{if choice:bday.bram.gift}Hm. Your turn. Iron. One bar. Fair trade.{else}Best birthday in years. Hm. Here. Iron. Don't make it a thing.{/if}{/if}
event.bram_birthday.after.why: each branch covers the iron bar he gives back

event.overheard_juno_bram_1.l2.text: Hm. Tongs know which is which. Ask them.

event.overheard_juno_bram_1.l4.text: Then peel the one off my apron. I know I'm Bram.
event.overheard_juno_bram_1.l4.why: the label joke turns on him; funniest word last

event.overheard_juno_bram_3.l2.text: Hm. Saw it. Keep it. Every bench needs one honest mistake.

event.overheard_juno_bram_4.l2.text: Good. Make it next door. I'll visit. Daily.
event.overheard_juno_bram_4.l2.why: the Next Door thread, and he can't let her go far

event.overheard_bram_marcus_2.l3.why: moved Hm; the best friendship in a craft image

event.overheard_bram_marcus_3.l3.text: Mine were straighter. Yours were more.

event.overheard_tilda_bram_1.l2.text: Hm. Hinges were squeaking. Bothered me. That's all.
event.overheard_tilda_bram_1.l2.why: denies the kindness by blaming the hinges

adds.text: Hm. Now it listens. Strike. Hear that? That's heat done right.
adds.why: keeps the old line's best phrase as the strike beat

adds.text: Took me three winters to see that. My teacher saw it from the door.
adds.why: first, quiet mention of the teacher; goes after the strike line

adds.text: My teacher kept his tools like that. Hm. I should tell him so.

threads.bram_heart2: Who was the teacher who could see heat from the door?
threads.bram_heart5: Will Bram ever tell his teacher, and how?
threads.story_whistler_bram: The tune and its wrong note came from his teacher; where is that teacher now?
threads.bram_heart4: Juno is better than Bram lets her hear.
threads.bram_heart6: The letters are still in the drawer, for now.
threads.bram_heart8: Will he actually tell Juno, today or near today?
threads.bram_heart10: Bram saved the gold for years; what else has he been saving?
threads.bram_friend: Marcus and Bram's bench: what does Marcus do on Wednesdays?
threads.bram_birthday: No other mail came; who does Bram wait to hear from?

notes: dlg.bram.long.0: the bible wants his longest sentence ever, but the lint caps Bram at 12 words per sentence; I wrote it at exactly 12. Raise the cap for this key if the beat should run longer.

event.bram_heart10.thanks: the bible says he says the player's name for the first time here, but adding [player] would change the line's tokens (lint error). Consider adding [player] in a later pass with a lint exemption.
event.story_whistler_bram.intro had stage directions inside spoken text; removed. If the tune stopping matters, the Director could add a sfx or an emote note before the line.
bram_heart2 adds: both go after event.bram_heart2.1, in this order (strike line first, teacher line second).

Kept as shipped (already right): next_door none; overheard_juno_bram_2 both lines, overheard_juno_bram_3.l4, overheard_juno_bram_4.l4, all overheard_wren_bram lines (the four-word bet counts depend on them), bram_marcus l1 lines, tilda l4, birthday choices (c0 is a shipped line).
bram_heart4: the bible's heart 4 has the player bring a broken tool with ask/together/give-up choices; the card has hold/hammer/watch. I kept the card's meanings.
